takeaways: Dynamics 365 Project Operations connects project sales, planning, staffing, time, expenses, billing and financials around one shared project record.
Quotes, contracts, resource bookings and approved time and expense entries flow into billing models such as time and materials, fixed price or milestone billing.
It fits service firms that sell customer project work; simple internal task lists are better served by lighter tools like Planner.
hook: When sales, project managers and finance each keep their own version of a customer project, promises, hours and invoices drift apart. This Simply Explained episode walks project-based service businesses through Dynamics 365 Project Operations, from quote and contract to staffing, time tracking and billing, so the whole lifecycle stays connected.
